pages.quiz:
HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

4. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   B. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.

5. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   B. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   D. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   D. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   B. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.

8. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   C. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   C. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

12. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   D. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aligned and Non-Aligned Movements from 1970 to 2020 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain International Instruments of Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Global diversity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The 2nd Generation of Industrial revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. B — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Explain symbols used on a map

4. B — Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. B — Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. C — Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. C — Nairobi

11. A — Plan income and spending wisely

12. A — Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Aligned and Non-Aligned Movements from 1970 to 2020; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of International Instruments of Human Rights; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Global diversity; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The 2nd Generation of Industrial revolution; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
